data.long_meaning: Devyansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'deva' (god) and 'yansh' (gift). It signifies that the child is a divine gift bestowed upon the parents. The name Devyansh carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devyansh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
